newsitem.title: USA: SBS starts 1.8 mln shr public offering.
newsitem.headline: SBS starts 1.8 mln shr public offering.

text.p: SBS Technologies Inc said on Tueday it commenced a fully underwritten 1.8 million common share public offering at a price of $25.625 per share.
The company said it planned to use net proceeds to fund the acquisition of Bit 3 Computer Corp, repay long-term debt and for general working capital requirements.
SBS said it also agreed to sell up to another 270,000 shares in the offering in case of an over-allotment.
The offering was managed by an underwriting group led by Cowen & Co and SoundView Financial Group Inc, it said.
